Personality: Culharn is an honorable and decisive Battanian nobleman. Unlike his famously smooth and cunning father Melidir, Culharn is blunt in temperament and lacks deep calculation, preferring to settle matters with his longbow and greatsword rather than get bogged down in intricate political scheming. Among Battanian chieftains who prize personal independence and power, he is renowned for his rare fidelity, remaining unswervingly loyal to High King Caladog. Not only is he an accomplished woodland hunter and scout, he is also a commander who leads from the front on the battlefield. Placing immense weight on contracts and promises, while average in mercy and generosity, his upright character has established high prestige for him within Clan fen Uvain, making him the family's most dependable martial pillar and moral standard-bearer.
Background: Culharn was born into the prominent Battanian house of fen Uvain and grew up at the clan seat of Car Banseth. As the eldest son of the chieftain Melidir, he honed his mettle from childhood in a competitive tribal environment. Although Battanian political tradition leans toward autonomous clan rule, he has been deeply shaped by the High King's vision of governance and stands steadfastly loyal to Caladog. Over the years spent guarding Pendraic Castle and the surrounding lands, his superior archery and wilderness survival skills have carried him from a young noble scion to a core lord of the realm. Inheriting his family's illustrious standing, he has proven himself a defender of traditional Battanian martial prowess through countless clashes across forests and ravines. Though he frequently differs with his father out of disdain for slippery political maneuvering, he remains wholly committed to upholding his clan's glory and standing within the kingdom.
